officialSendingAgency.name: MIGRATION AGENCY UNDER THE CABINET OF MINSTERS OF THE REPUBLIC OF UZBEKISTAN (AELM)

currentInformationOffice.address: 1, Qamarniso Str, Tashkent, Olmazor district, Uzbekistan

evidenceNotes: HRD Korea lists the Uzbekistan sending agency as the Migration Agency under the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan (AELM).
The 9th Uzbekistan Point System route is explicitly Manufacturing, General CBT and Point System.
Registration ran 2026-03-09 through 2026-03-12; test announcement was 2026-03-23; test period was 2026-04-06 through 2026-04-22.

HRD Korea's general information-office listing and the cycle-specific schedule page show different official contact details; KEP preserves both with their source context rather than silently reconciling them.

HRD Korea's official skills-candidate row (2026-05-27) and final Point System result row (2026-08-27) both use examNot=9, matching the direct 9th Manufacturing schedule. Fee, exact registration document checklist and downstream medical/visa/departure details remain HOLD.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Use the current Uzbekistan notice for complete cycle-specific eligibility. HRD Korea's general EPS eligibility may be used only as a preparation baseline and must not replace a local current-cycle notice.

stages.title: 9th Point System registration
stages.action: The 9th Uzbekistan Manufacturing Point System registration period was 2026-03-09 through 2026-03-12. The window is closed.

stages.title: Application / test fee
stages.action: KEP has not promoted a cycle-specific Uzbekistan 9th-round fee. The generic HRD visiting-registration US$28 baseline is not treated as an Uzbekistan current-cycle exact fee.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Follow only identity and anti-fraud requirements in current Uzbekistan instructions. KEP does not infer extra biometric rules from another country.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.action: The exact 9th-round passport/photo/upload/payment checklist has not yet been reconstructed from a current Uzbekistan notice. Do not reuse another country's checklist.

stages.title: Test-date notice
stages.action: HRD Korea records the official test announcement date as 2026-03-23 for the 9th Uzbekistan Manufacturing Point System.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — 9th Point System
stages.action: HRD Korea records the Manufacturing test period as 2026-04-06 through 2026-04-22 and identifies the route as General CBT Point System.

stages.title: Skills Test — Round 2
stages.action: HRD Korea's official skills-candidate row published 2026-05-27 uses examNot=9, exactly matching the 9th Uzbekistan Manufacturing schedule. Rows 34/35/36 are not imported.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.action: HRD Korea's official Point System final-result row published 2026-08-27 uses examNot=9, exactly matching the 9th Uzbekistan Manufacturing schedule. Final test selection does not guarantee employer selection.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Uzbekistan psychology stage is asserted from the verified sources. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology rules.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.action: Use only current Uzbekistan EPS medical instructions and authorized-provider guidance. Exact 9th-round provider, checklist and fee remain HOLD.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.action: After official final selection, follow current Uzbekistan job-application instructions. Exact 9th-round candidate-file documents and timing remain HOLD.

stages.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
stages.action: Only officially qualified candidates proceed to the EPS employer-selection process. No intermediary can guarantee roster priority.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS system. A private intermediary cannot guarantee a specific employer.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected by a Korean employer, follow current official Uzbekistan/EPS instructions for SLC review/signing and next steps.

stages.title: Post-SLC Uzbekistan requirements
stages.action: Follow only current official instructions for medical follow-up, training, visa, fees and departure preparation.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use the current Uzbekistan/Korean-mission visa checklist and fees. Exact current 9th-round downstream details are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.action: Complete only the official pre-departure training assigned to selected Korea-bound workers. Exact duration/location/fees remain current-notice specific.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow current Uzbekistan instructions if a final health recheck is required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.action: Travel only after official contract, visa, training and departure requirements are complete and the official departure process is issued.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
